artworks.title: The Battle of Salamis
artworks.description: Kaulbach's vast history painting stages the Persian defeat at Salamis with Artemisia of Halicarnassus at center-left, loosing arrows above the Greek fleet beneath Xerxes' throne — the Carian queen Herodotus praised as the only Persian-side commander worthy of naming.

films.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
films.description: Eva Green plays Artemisia as Xerxes' naval commander — a stylized, vengeful Halicarnassian admiral opposite the Greek fleet at Artemisium and Salamis.

films.title: The 300 Spartans
films.description: Hollywood's Cold-War Thermopylae film brings Artemisia into the Persian court and the Aegean campaign — an early screen face for the Halicarnassian queen.

popCulture.title: Artemisia I of Caria
popCulture.description: Queen of Halicarnassus who fought for Xerxes at Salamis — Herodotus' model of a woman commander, and the namesake later ages confuse with Artemisias of Caria and painting.
